name: Mumbletuft · Gremlet #50
description:
A haystack that grumbles to itself in the field. It's actually very friendly.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Mumbletuft in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
